main.description: Download an account's permissioned repo within a space as a STAR file, for full-state recovery. The archive's metadata carries the repo's DID, the space, and the signed commit; each key/value pair is a record path ('{collection}/{rkey}') and the record's DRISL encoding, in strict lexicographic order of the path. Blobs are not included and are fetched separately via getBlob. Served by a repo host. Callable with either OAuth (for the authenticated user's own data) or a space credential (for syncing services).

repo.description: The DID of the account whose repo to download.
